instructions_suffix: Answer in plain text with any SQL or code you would use. Do not run commands, call MotherDuck, or change files.

tasks.prompt: In MotherDuck, the EU sales team should only see EU rows of sales.main.orders, and nobody outside finance should see the customer_email column. How do I set this up with a share?

must.why: row and column rules on shares use secure views
policy keys on consumer identity

must_not.why: secure views should use explicit column lists

tasks.prompt: Add an Approve button to my MotherDuck Dive that marks the selected order as approved in ops.main.orders.

must.why: Dives write by starting a Flight
the write happens in a Flight

tasks.prompt: My MotherDuck Dive has a Refresh button that runs a Flight I own. I want the finance team to use the Dive. What do I need to set up?

must.why: viewers need a run grant on the Flight
viewers need to read the Dive's data

tasks.prompt: I have 2 million support tickets in support.main.tickets. I want to label each one as billing, bug, or feature request as cheaply as possible, directly in MotherDuck SQL.

must.why: closed classification uses prompt_jev
a fixed label set uses the choice question

must_not.why: use SQL AI functions, not an SDK

tasks.prompt: I have a nightly MotherDuck Flight that only runs three SQL statements against MotherDuck and finishes in two minutes. Which Flight size should it use?

must.why: SQL-only Flights fit the smallest size
SQL over md: runs on a Duckling

tasks.prompt: My MotherDuck Flight has five steps and sometimes fails halfway. How can I see which step failed and how long each step took?

must.why: Flight Explainer instrumentation

tasks.prompt: I'm building a Vercel serverless function in TypeScript that runs a few small queries against MotherDuck per request. How should it connect?

must.why: thin serverless clients use the Postgres endpoint
tokens come from the environment

tasks.prompt: My Python API server connects to MotherDuck with duckdb.connect('md:analytics'). Sometimes the first request hangs for a long time while the Duckling starts. How do I make it fail fast so I can retry elsewhere?

must.why: bounded connect is the documented fix

tasks.prompt: Load 500 Parquet files from s3://acme-raw/events/ into a MotherDuck table raw.main.events.

must.why: bulk load with read_parquet
private buckets need a secret

tasks.prompt: We have a 2 TB events table in MotherDuck and just want fast dashboards. Should we move it to DuckLake?

must.why: native storage is the default for read-heavy dashboards

tasks.prompt: Our metric definitions live in Markdown in a Git repo. How do we keep them synced to MotherDuck Guides from CI?

must.why: the CLI manages Guides as files
push creates or updates a Guide

tasks.prompt: How do I list every service account in our MotherDuck organization through the API?

must.why: GET /v1/users lists users and service accounts
filter to service accounts

tasks.prompt: We're a B2B SaaS with 300 customers and want to embed per-customer analytics in our app backed by MotherDuck. How should we isolate tenants?

must.why: structural isolation is the default
one service account per customer boundary

tasks.prompt: Build me a revenue dashboard Dive from my sales database in MotherDuck.

must.why: read the Dive guide before writing Dive code

tasks.prompt: My MotherDuck Dive looks broken on phones and needs a dark mode. How should I fix the layout?

must.why: start from a narrow viewport
theme tokens with dark mode

tasks.prompt: We're migrating from Snowflake to MotherDuck. Our Snowflake setup uses row access policies and masking policies. How do we carry those over?

must.why: secure views replace row access and masking policies

tasks.prompt: Set up a daily ingestion of Stripe charges into MotherDuck and model them for reporting.

must.why: scheduled ingestion runs on Flights
reruns must be safe

tasks.prompt: Write a MotherDuck query for daily revenue over the last 30 days from shop.main.orders (columns: order_ts timestamp, amount decimal).

must.why: fully qualified table name

tasks.prompt: Our MotherDuck bill went up. How can I tell which pipelines and Flights are using the most compute?

must.why: attribute compute by user agent
where the attribution data lives

tasks.prompt: I just got access to a MotherDuck workspace. How do I find which tables have customer data and what their grain is?

must.why: catalog discovery
